descriptions.notStarted: You have now reached the apex of the Maple world, the one who is considered the ultimate thief. To commemorate your sterling accomplishment of reaching level 200,  #b#p2081400##k has something in store for you.
descriptions.inProgress: It's the one thing that countless thieves, the dominant forces in the dark, strived for, but couldn't get... but now, #p2081400# is introducing me to #t1902002#... I heard only the very best in the world of Maple can be friends with #t1902002#.
descriptions.completed: At a point where I never thought I could go any higher, I made a new friend that certainly put me over the top.
